_comment: Venues that sit BETWEEN two countries (a bridge over a border river, a point on the line or in the neutral zone). Unlike venue_fixes.json (one fixed side per venue, everywhere), each check-in here counts for the side you were on before it: the country of the previous check-in (within 12 h, other straddle venues skipped). With no earlier check-in it takes the side opposite the next one (you were crossing towards it), else the venue_fixes / Foursquare side. venue_id -> {country: city on that side}. Used ONLY by the index By Days count (transform.straddle_sides via metrics.stats): the feed, D1 and every other stat keep the venue's own side. User decision 2026-11-11/12.
